data.value: The contacts are invalid, exceed limits or use unsupported encoding or columns. Use UTF-8 vCard 3.0/4.0 or a contact table with supported headers and text values; unknown nonempty import columns are rejected.

data.value: Tables contain common name, organization, title, notes, phone, email and address fields, not photos or every vendor field. Use one worksheet with text cells when importing Excel. vCard 2.1, quoted-printable and embedded binary encodings are unsupported. Originals are kept.

data.value: Exports common vCard contact fields to new XLSX workbooks with text cells; Excel does not need to be installed.

data.name: ContactDesc_csv-to-vcf
data.value: Converts UTF-8 CSV or TSV contact tables with supported headers into new vCard 3.0 files.

data.name: ContactDesc_xlsx-to-vcf
data.value: Converts single-sheet XLSX contact tables with text values into new vCard 3.0 files without running Excel.
